title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use blue and red lines for the left and right cameras and for the two rays; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette and line styles that stay distinguishable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both rays distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: camera calibration from a checkerboard
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. The shipped sessions assume perfect calibration, which no real camera pair has.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: cameras that are not parallel
body:
## Problem
Session 1 and Session 3 use parallel (rectified) camera pairs; real rigs toe in towards the flame.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app that triangulate from two general projection matrices and search along the epipolar line.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The roadmap checkpoint is met and shown in a figure
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target with your own code and a real flame photo set
body:
## Problem
The Target shows a synthetic reconstruction; there is no public pipeline that goes from real photos to a flame volume with an error bar.

## Context
The roadmap gives the path; the Session 3 code is the starting point.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation written from the roadmap, run on photos of a candle or burner taken with two cameras, plus a short write-up of the method and its error.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Volume reported with an uncertainty
- [ ] Short write-up of your method and what you calibrated

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
